reason: I do one big hypermarket shop a week with my spouse and keep a list in my head, so scanning receipts every time sounds like extra work. The free part is fine to try, but I would not pay for another subscription when most apps are free.
objection: Another subscription? Most of these apps are free, and my husband and I already buy duplicates; I doubt scanning receipts would fix that enough to pay monthly.
would_change_my_mind: If the free version let me share the list with my spouse and scan receipts a few times a month, and I saw it actually stop us buying duplicates, I might pay for the year.
